summary: Assembler, BASIC, media and tests for retro systems
intro: vcc is the command-line tool of VintageCoder. It translates assembler and BASIC for C64, C128, Plus/4, VIC-20, Atari 8-bit and MEGA65, creates projects, builds disks and runs tests.

overview_examples.title: assemble (the target is set in the source)

env.name: VC_DATA
env.help: Folder of the hardware database (data); otherwise next to the program or in the working folder.

env.name: VC_ROMS
env.help: The user's ROM folder (instead of roms/ in the configuration folder).

env.name: VC_XEMU
env.help: Path to the Xemu program (MEGA65 emulator).

env.name: VC_XEMU_ARGS
env.help: Extra arguments when starting Xemu, separated by spaces.

env.name: VC_STRUCTURES
env.help: File with your own project templates (otherwise structures.json in the configuration folder).

env.name: VC_UPDATE_URL
env.help: Source of the version list for vcc update (folder, file or https address; otherwise the fixed release update-feed). Never changes the target of the link.

env.name: VC_UPDATE_DIR
env.help: Folder for the result and check log of the update check (otherwise updates in the configuration folder).

env.name: VC_DEBUG_LOG
env.help: Turn on the debug log: 1 (default file logs/vintagecoder.log in the configuration folder) or a file path; 0 turns it off. Applies to vintagecoder and vcc.

env.name: VC_WIN
env.help: Window size of the IDE, e.g. 1400x860 (vintagecoder only).

env.name: COLUMNS
env.help: Width for line wrapping of the help (default: 100).

env.name: NO_COLOR
env.help: No colors in the help output.

exit.help: error (in the source, in a check or during execution)
wrong usage (unknown command or unknown option)
